title: Repeated one-liners in compositor.rs
body:
Each row is a sequence written at several sites in `compositor.rs` that one method would replace.

| sequence | sites | one home |
|---|---|---|
| workspace id to index with `.unwrap_or(0)` | `current`, `show`, `render_to`, beside the existing `workspace_index` | `workspace_index` or `viewer_workspace(viewer)` |
| `if let Some(active) = self.active { self.show(active, id) }` | `new_workspace`, `picker_outcome`, `frame_hit`, the `NextNeeding` key | `show_on_active(id)` |
| refocus the focused pane if this workspace and tab are shown | `remove_pane`, `toplevel_destroyed` twice | `refocus(workspace, tab)` |
| change a viewer's shown workspace and send `Showing` | `show`, the `Hello` arm, `finish_closing` | `set_shown(viewer, id)` |
| `self.start.elapsed().as_millis() as u32` | four sites | `now()` |
| `chrome_changed` forwards to `request_redraw` | four callers | call `request_redraw` |
| the `Resize` arm sets `active = None` so that `make_active` calls `set_active` | one site | call `set_active(Some(id))` |
| `wants_redraw` is copied into every viewer's `wants_frame` on the next loop | `request_redraw`, `render_viewers`, `render` | `request_redraw` sets `wants_frame` directly and `render` returns `animating` |
| `app_id(surface)` and `panes::Client::label` both open `XdgToplevelSurfaceData` through `with_states` | `compositor.rs`, `panes.rs` | one accessor |
| `crossed(seen, newest)` renames `<` and has a four-assert test | one caller | inline |
| `ClientData for ClientState` and `ServerDndGrabHandler::send` restate empty defaults | two impls | `impl .. {}` |
| `Face` match maps `Chrome` and `Icon` to the same font | `Paint::scene` | `Face::Menu => menu_font, _ => font` |

The `Hello` arm sends `Showing { id: workspaces[0].id }` while `viewer.workspace` was set at connect time; the two differ if the picker reorders workspaces first. The viewer ignores `Showing` today, so nothing shows it.
